name: Pechna
desc: A TCG player who can be found reading the latest novels, particularly ones that are entertaining. Whilst she prefers reading as her chosen activity to kill some time, she struggles to remember any of the plots or characters after finishing.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd680>Stage Introduction</color>
"I read about this in a collection of foreign legends. It's about a monster formed from countless lives and wills fused into one..." Pechna said as she opened her Genius Invokation TCG card case in excitement.

customize.desc:
Thunder in the Mist: Electro Cicin Mage

...Just as the scent of Mist Grass intoxicates the Electro Cicins, so too does the sadistic mage hanker after the pleasure of toying with her foe...

"Awakened Egregore" Hydro Tulpa

A human-shaped monster formed from the agglomeration of countless drops of water.

customize.name: Maguu Kenki

Even today, it still patrols the place where fate was severed.

customize.name: Lucky Coin
customize.desc: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. It is said that these coins were initially named as such in the hopes that they would bring those carrying them luck. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...
